news.title: Australia's bizarre 'Spider Crater' seen from orbit | Space photo of the day for Oct. 22, 2026
paras: Somewhere in the vast Western Australia wilderness lies a giant "spider" trapped in an ancient impact crater. From the dangerous Sydney funnel-web to the common huntsman, Australia is home to its fair share of spiders.

It even has a crater shaped like one. One stretch of the vast Western Australia wilderness is imprinted with a curious crater, which likely formed after a meteor impact hundreds of millions of years ago. Geologists think the spider-like pattern in the crater's center was created when its floor rebounded following the initial impact, NASA has said .
